title: Brighton Hove Leads Premier League DFT Tally on 14 Pts as Arsenal Tops Full-Time Table (27 Pts)
summary: Brighton Hove holds the Diploman Football Tally (DFT) lead in Premier League (PL) with 14 two-half points as of 2026-11-20 UTC, while Arsenal leads the standard full-time table on 27 points.
